scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:db && pnpm run dev:prisma && pnpm run -w --parallel --stream "/^dev:(website|desktop|server)$/"
scripts.dev:db: docker compose --env-file server/.env -f server/compose.yml up -d postgres
scripts.dev:prisma: sh -c 'set -a; . server/.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @synapse/server run prisma:migrate'
scripts.dev:server: sh -c 'set -a; . server/.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @synapse/server run dev'
scripts.quit: pnpm run quit:docker; pnpm run quit:processes
scripts.quit:processes: ps aux | grep -E 'scripts/dev\.mjs|dev-renderer|dev-electron-app|tsc.*tsconfig\.electron\.json.*--watch|vite\.js.*strictPort|vitepress.*dev|nest.*start.*--watch|admin/vite\.config\.ts|Synapse.*Electron|electron \.' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Done.'
